description: Use when the user asks what is being tracked or wants to change it. Returns the brand's plan, markets, rivals, Custom topics (each with its id, the question it reads as, its source: "Added by you", "Drafted by Parse" or the market it belongs to, and how many ways Parse asks it) and the user's own notification switches. Read-only. On Pro, parse_add_question, parse_remove_question, parse_correct_rival and parse_set_notification change one.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.
